translations.web: Moreover those who work in combed flax, and those who weave white cloth, will be confounded.
translations.bsb: The workers in flax will be dismayed, and the weavers of fine linen will turn pale.
translations.kjv: Moreover they that work in fine flax, and they that weave networks, shall be confounded.
